change.title: chore: release v0.4.10
change.description:
## Summary

Bump the version string from 0.4.9 to 0.4.10 across all five tracked locations so a fresh stable release tag can be cut. The v0.4.9 tag could not be re-triggered (GitHub Actions only runs jobs on a tag's first push), so v0.4.10 carries the same body of work plus the release.yml macOS-optional fix already on main.

## Related Issue

Closes #

No related issue - release chore.

## Type of Change

- [ ] feat: new feature
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] style: formatting or non-functional styling changes
- [ ] refactor: internal cleanup with no behavior change
- [ ] perf: performance improvement
- [ ] test: adds or updates tests
- [ ] build: build or dependency changes
- [ ] ci: CI/CD workflow changes
- [ ] revert: reverts a previous change

## What Changed

- Version 0.4.9 -> 0.4.10 in package.json, src-tauri/Cargo.toml, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, src-tauri/Cargo.lock, src/renderer/components/ProjectSidebar.tsx (sidebar label).

## How It Was Tested

- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` (in src-tauri)
- [ ] `cargo test` (in src-tauri)
- [ ] Not applicable

## Screenshots or Recordings

N/A - version-only bump, no UI change.

## CI & Review Gate

- [ ] Code review comments from CodeRabbit / Claude have been addressed or resolved
- [ ] No unresolved review findings remain

## Checklist

- [ ] A human reviewed the complete diff before submission
